item.title: Zomato leading in valuation from Swiggy : HSBC Research - The VC Talks
item.description: According to HSBC Global Research, Zomato is leading Swiggy with the valuation of $3.6-Bn considering the upcoming fresh capital raise.

item.title: Binny Bansal invested in online insurance player Acko - The VC Talks
item.description: Acko General Insurance raised $65 Mn in its Series C round from Flipkart's co-founder Binny Bansal, Kabir Misra from RPS Venture and Intact Ventures.

item.title: Oyo enteres co-working industry with the buyout of Innov8 - The VC Talks
item.description: Oyo acquires the co-working space company Innvo8 for Rs. 220 Crores in an all-cash deal. Two new brands also introduced by Oyo - PowerStation and WorkFlo.

item.title: How India is becoming the hub of music streaming - The VC Talks
item.description: India has scored a 9th position in the Global Revenue Ranking (2019) in Music Streaming with a revenue of $213 Mn with user base of 137 million.

item.title: Kunal Shah Founded Cred In Talks To Raise $100 Million - The VC Talks
item.description: Cred is a Bangalore based Fintech startup which claims to be the most rewarding credit card payment app ever. Cred is in talks to raised $100 million.

item.title: PUBG Publisher Tencent To Launch WeChat Pay In India - The VC Talks
item.description: PUBG Publisher Tencent is about to launch its UPI-powered payment app WeChat Pay in India which is the second largest payment app in China.

item.title: Delhivery hits unicorn club after the investment of Softbank - The VC Talks
item.description: Gurugram based Logistic start-up Delhivery freezes its Series-F funding from Softbank. The Carlyle Group and Fosun was also part of this investment.

item.title: Online Video Shopping App Bulbul Raises INR 14 Crores From Sequoia Capital - The VC Talks
item.description: Sachin Bhatia's third venture - Bulbul: A Hinglish Video Shopping App has secured INR 14 crores in its seed funding round. Bulbul is an influencer driven, e-commerce app, launched in March 2019.

item.title: Parenting Baby Care and Pregnancy Tips App Healofy Raises $8 Mn from BabyTree and others - The VC Talks
item.description: The Women App; Healofy is a mobile-based pregnancy-parenting social network. It is specially designed for Indian babies, moms, and Pregnant mommies. Healofy has developed a fine community of expert doctors and parents or expectant parents to discuss questions related to pregnancy and parenting.

item.title: Alteria Capital ropes Oye Rickshaw in its Portfolio with the backing of INR 24 Crores
item.description: E-Rickshaw booking company Oye! Rickshaw has raised the capital sum of Rupees 24 Crores in its latest funding round from the venture debt fund Alteria Capital.
